data.name: Wood
data.gender_notes: Wood is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Wood is derived from the Old English word 'wudu,' meaning 'wood, tree, or forest.' Historically, wood has been a symbol of strength, resilience, and longevity. In Christian tradition, wood is also associated with the cross of Jesus Christ, reminding us of His sacrifice and enduring love. The name Wood carries the meaning “Strong, sturdy, and long-lasting” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Wood usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, sturdy, and long-lasting and live with faith, good character and purpose.
